newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bond market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bond market closing report.

text.p: Swiss bonds ended higher, setting forth a rally which began on January 8 when the contract traded as low as 115.45.
The March confederate bond futures contract ended at a new contract high of 117.00.

Swiss bonds followed global bond prices higher, which rose after release of U.S. consumer price and retail sales data for December. Consumer prices rose 0.3 percent, and 0.1 percent excluding food and energy. Retail sales rose 0.6 percent. Swiss bonds may also have gained as a result of the slightly firmer tone in the Swiss franc.
Mar Comi medium-term bond up 36 at 111.65
Mar Euro Swiss francs down one at 98.20.
